central_idea_and_construction: Exactly NL as two separate readable uppercase initials for a warm boutique guesthouse. Draw broad elegant N and L in a soft editorial serif with curved bracketed serifs and medium stroke contrast. N has softly flaring stems and a rounded meeting at its diagonal; L has a gently cupped foot that sweeps slightly upward at the end, echoing a quiet upholstered seat. Letters sit next to each other on the same baseline, do not overlap or share strokes. A carefully balanced open interval separates the N diagonal from the L stem. Rich muted aubergine flat ink. Centered compact two-letter signature, 58% canvas width. No squared monoliths, stencil cuts, mountains, compass, arrow, shield or hotel crest.
background_role: plain white negative space; no inset outer tile
material: flat ink / pixel clusters; no material rendering
small_size_signature: Readable N/L and the cupped serif feet.
specific_risk: Heavy serif contrast must not become spindly at smaller header widths.
reference_transfer: Negative user screenshots analyzed as text: avoid severed slabs and nested squared Ls; no positive visual reference or borrowed signature.
observations: Recorded separately after viewing actual output.
